resources.string: LibreHU-service not found. This screen controls the audio processor of a Jancar / Autochips head unit (ROHM BD37534) through LibreHU-service: https://github.com/LibreHU/LibreHU-service

LibreHU-service is not driving the hardware (%1$s). Settings are saved and applied when it starts. If Jancar ivi-services is still enabled, disable it: adb shell pm disable-user --user 0 com.jancar.services
Ignition is off: the audio processor stays muted.
Master volume of the head unit audio processor, after Android and ViPER. It applies to every source.

Moves the sound between the four speakers. This is done by the head unit audio processor, after Android and ViPER.

• Balance — left / right.
• Fader — front / rear.
Bass, middle and treble controls of the head unit audio processor (2 dB per step). They apply to every source, unlike ViPER effects which only process Android audio.
Loudness (bass and treble boost at low volume), subwoofer output (low-pass at 120 Hz) and subwoofer level (−5 to +7 dB).
Turns on the remote (REM) output that powers up an external amplifier, usually the blue/white wire of the harness. LibreHU-service switches it on with the ignition when enabled.
